author: Animalogic
description:
Meet the Highland Tiger, also known as the Scottish wildcat, the rarest cat in the world. With a pure wildlife population of only about 50, these are the last surviving felids in the British Isles.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
